title: Balanced Parentheses
summary: Uses a stack to verify every opening bracket has a matching close in the right order.
usage: Expression parsing, compiler/syntax validation, editor bracket matching.

steps.title: Input: ( [ ] )
steps.explanation: Scan left to right. Push opening brackets.

steps.title: Read ']'
steps.explanation: Closing — top is '[', it matches, so pop.

input.prompt: Does ']' correctly match the stack top '['?

steps.title: Read ')'
steps.explanation: Closing — top is '(', matches, pop. Stack empty.

steps.title: Valid
steps.explanation: Stack is empty at the end — the string is balanced.
